headline: Colombia Proposes Sweeping Overhaul to Eliminate 105 Public Entities
summary: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has proposed eliminating, dissolving, or merging 105 of the 209 entities in the national executive branch as part of a fiscal adjustment strategy.
why: Government administrative restructuring aims to cut public spending and streamline state bureaucracy to meet fiscal consolidation goals.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Sweeping structural reforms affect government spending and administrative efficiency.
